lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᏚᏃᏁᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏎ ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏧᎩᎵᏲᏤᏗᏱ ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸᎠᏁᎶᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ; ᎠᎴ ᎠᏥᎢᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏦᎢᏁ ᎢᎦ ᏧᎴᏗᏱ.
lines.text: Hna-quo-no Tsi-sa u-le-nv-hv-gi du-no-ne-lv-gi gv-wa-s-da-wa-di-do-hi a-se u-we-nv-s-di-yi ge-sv Tsi-lu-si-li-mi, A-le tsu-da-le-nv-dv tsu-gi-li-yo-tse-di-yi di-ni-la-wi-gi a-le nu-ni-gv-wi-yu-sv a-tsi-lv-a-ne-lo-hi a-le di-no-we-li-s-gi; a-le a-tsi-i-s-di-yi, a-le tso-i-ne i-ga tsu-le-di-yi.
lines.english: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
lines.emitted_text: nakwunatsihsa ulenvhvki v tunonhelvki a yvwhstawatitohi ahse uwenvhsti yikehsv tsiluhsalami alatsutalenhvta tsukilhiyotshehtiyi tinilawiki ale vv unikvwiyuhsv atsila anelhohi alatinowhelihski ale atsi'ihstiyi e ilatsohine ikv tsulehtiyi

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏈᏓ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏭᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏭᏅᏍᏙᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎨᏣᎵᏍᏓᏏ.
lines.text: Hna-quo-no Qui-da i-yv-dv wu-ti-nv-s-ta-nv u-le-nv-hv-gi u-da-nv-s-da-de-lv-gi, hi-a nu-we-sv-gi, U-ne-la-nv-hi wu-nv-s-do-hi, Tsa-gv-wi-yu-hi, v-tla na-s-gi yi-nv-ge-tsa-li-s-da-si.
lines.english: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸ ᏈᏓ; ᎠᏆᏐᎭᏛ ᎭᎴᎲᎦ, ᏎᏓᏂ, ᏗᏍᏉᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩᏉ ᏂᎯ, ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏯᏓᏅᏕᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᏴᏫᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᎭᏓᏅᏕᎭ.
lines.text: U-ga-ta-hv-sv-no hi-a na-tsi-we-se-lv Qui-da; A-qua-so-ha-dv ha-le-hv-ga, Se-da-ni, di-s-quo-de-s-di-s-gi-quo ni-hi, v-tla-ye-no ya-da-nv-de-ha U-ne-la-nv-hi u-tse-li-ga, yv-wi-quo-s-gi-ni u-na-tse-li ha-da-nv-de-ha.
lines.english: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ; ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏚᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᏓᏓᏱᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎠᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Hna-quo-no Tsi-sa hi-a ni-du-we-se-lv-gi gv-wa-s-da-wa-di-do-hi; I-yu-no gi-lo u-du-li-s-ge-s-di a-gi-s-du-wa-dv-s-di-yi, a-da-da-yi-he-s-di u-wa-sv, a-le tsu-da-hna-wa-dv a-yi-s-ge-s-di, a-le a-gi-s-da-wa-de-ge-s-di.
lines.english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Gi-lo-ye-no u-du-li-s-ge-s-di u-s-de-lv-di-yi gv-nv-i, u-yo-hu-se-di ge-se-s-di; gi-lo-no u-yo-hu-se-he-s-di gv-nv-i, a-yv nv-di-ga-li-s-do-di-s-ge-s-di, u-wa-dv-di ge-se-s-di.
lines.english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎦᏙ ᏴᏫ ᏳᏁᏉᏥ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎡᎳᏂᎬ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ, ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ ᏳᏲᎱᏎᎸ; ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙ ᏯᎲᎦ ᏴᏫ ᏱᎦᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏙ.
lines.text: Ga-do yv-wi yu-ne-quo-tsi i-yu-no e-la-ni-gv u-tse-li yi-nu-li-s-ta-nv, u-da-nv-do-no yu-yo-hu-se-lv; a-le ga-do ya-hv-ga yv-wi yi-ga-ne-tli-yv-s-da u-da-nv-do.
lines.english: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏙᏛᎫᏴᎡᎵ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ.
lines.text: Yv-wi-ye-no U-we-tsi da-ga-lu-tsi U-do-da u-tse-li ga-lv-quo-di-yu ge-sv u-nu-wo-s-de-s-di, a-le di-ni-ka-hna-wa-di-do-hi da-ti-ne-he-s-di; hna-quo-no do-dv-gu-yv-e-li na-ni-v yv-wi nu-s-dv du-ni-lv-wi-s-da-ne-lv-i.
lines.english: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏂ ᏓᏂᏙᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᎾᏙᎴᎰᏏ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎬᏂ ᎠᏂᎪᎲᎭ ᏴᏫ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸᎭ.
lines.text: U-do-hi-yu-hi-ya hi-a ni-tsv-we-se-ha, Gi-lo a-ni da-ni-do-ga v-tla yv-dv-na-do-le-ho-si a-yo-hu-hi-s-di ge-sv-i, gv-ni a-ni-go-hv-ha yv-wi U-we-tsi na-hna u-gv-wi-yu-hi ge-sv ga-na-nu-go-tsi-lv-ha.
lines.english: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
